question: How do I make a clip's picture fade out at the end?
criteria: Uses the clip-end fade handle or Fade Out effect
Does not apply an audio fade as the solution

question: How do I split one timeline clip exactly where I placed my playhead?
criteria: Places playhead at the cut point
Uses Cut Clip on selected timeline clip or explains equivalent Razor action
Does not delete either resulting half

question: When I drag a clip into the timeline, why do I see separate pieces on audio and video tracks?
criteria: Explains Kdenlive places video and audio streams on their respective tracks
Does not claim the original file was split or duplicated
Does not advise deleting a stream as a fix

question: Can I fade up from black at the beginning and set the fade to one second?
criteria: Uses Fade In or the start fade handle
Enables Fade from black if not already on
